nvitk.gui.viz.loc_points
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.loc_points

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Load QVTpy ``locs.csv`` and display as Napari Points layers.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: LOC_CSV_COLUMNS
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('vessel_id', 'vessel_name', 'segment_id', 'loc_role', 'centerline_index', 'i', 'j', 'k',...


.. py:data:: LOC_LAYER_NAME
   :value: 'LOCs'


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_LOC_POINT_SIZE
   :value: 2.0


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_LOC_FACE_COLOR
   :value: '#ff0000'


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_LOC_SYMBOL
   :value: 'o'


.. py:data:: LOC_SNAP_DISTANCE_VOX
   :type:  float
   :value: 2.5


.. py:class:: LocPose

   Stage-5 LOC geometry: the exact pose stage 6 measures flow at.


   .. py:attribute:: vessel_id
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: vessel_name
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: loc_role
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: center
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: tangent
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: centerline_index
      :type:  int | None
      :value: None



   .. py:method:: label() -> str

      Short display label including optional role (init/fin).



.. py:function:: parse_loc_poses(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[LocPose]

   Build :class:`LocPose` entries from stage-5 ``locs.csv`` row dicts.


.. py:function:: nearest_loc_pose(poses: Sequence[LocPose], xyz: numpy.ndarray, *, max_distance_vox: float = LOC_SNAP_DISTANCE_VOX) -> LocPose | None

   Closest LOC within *max_distance_vox*, or ``None`` if none are near enough.


.. py:function:: load_locs_csv(path: str | pathlib.Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]

   Read stage-5 style ``locs.csv`` into a list of row dicts.


.. py:function:: locs_to_napari_points(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], reference_layer: Any | None) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, dict[str, numpy.ndarray]]

   Build Napari point coordinates and per-point feature columns.

   Prefers sub-voxel ``centerline_x/y/z`` when present; falls back to ``i/j/k``.


.. py:function:: add_locs_layer(viewer: Any, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], *, reference_layer=None, name=LOC_LAYER_NAME) -> Any

   Add or replace a Points layer for LOC rows.


.. py:function:: remove_locs_layer(viewer: Any, name: str = LOC_LAYER_NAME) -> None

   Remove the LOC points layer named *name* from *viewer*, if present.
